@machi1990 I think you partially deployed some new code but not everything.

Interesting. I am not sure how I could have done that. Indeed, I do not have it on my other computer. Is there a way to go around the error I was getting? 

I was potentially interested in reproducing it, which I have managed in our integration tests. To understand what could have caused the issue. The final goal was to propose a fix during the weekend. With the help of a mentor, see what really needs to be done in this method `addClassHierarchyToReflectiveList`.
@machi1990 just `mvn clean install -DskipTests -DskipITs` from the root of Quarkus.
It works., thanks. I was not running the `clean install` command on the  root dir of Quarkus.
